No. 1948/39 – TUESDAY, JANUARY 07, 2016
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My No.: WGSWD & EIP/ACQ/KB/15.
Land Ministry’s Ref. No.: 4/3/10/2012/LRB –323.

I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the land described below to create a water reserve in the paddy field located between 120 bus route and the sub canal stretches towards Piliyandala Gangarama Road from the Maha Ela at Bokundara under Weras Ganga Storm Water Drainage & Environment Improvement Project.

Description of the Land to be acquired: Seven (07) allotments of land in total extent of 0.1752 Hectare depicted as lot no. 180 to 186 in the Cadastral Map No. 521211 dated 17.12.2015 prepared by the Survey General situated in the Village called Bokundara in the Grama Niladari Division No. 575 of Bokundara in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Kesbewa in Colombo District of Western Province and more fully described as follows.

1. Lot No. : 180 Name of the land: Could not be traced; Description: Home Garden (part of a temporary building available); Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Could not be traced; Extent: 0.0133 Hectare.

2. Lot No. : 181 Name of the land: Parasthawala Idama at Colombo Road of which the assessment number not known; Description: Home Garden (permanent two storied building available); Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Mr. K. A. D. Jayantha Chandrasiri, No. 308, Kanaththagoda, Bandaragama; Extent: 0.0034 Hectare.

3. Lot No. : 182 Name of the land: Parasthawala Idama; Description: Home Garden (permanent two storied building available); Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Mr. Nilantha Indraji Madawala, No. 40/3, Madapatha Road, Mampe, Piliyandala; Extent: 0.0052 Hectare.

4. Lot No. : 183 Name of the land: Parasthawala Idama bearing assessment No. 595, and 597 at Colombo Road; Description: Home Garden (permanent two storied building available); Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Mr. Walpitagamage Sirisena, No. 33, Vidyala Mawatha, Piliyandala; Extent: 0.0104 Hectare.

5. Lot No. : 184 Name of the land: Kalasse Kumbura alias Ranmuduwawala Kumbura bearing assessment No. 370/3/1/A at Colombo Road; Description: Home Garden (a temporary building, part of a temporary building and a permanent building available); Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Haputhanthirige Upasena Kariyawasam, No. 113/10, Sri Dewananda Mawatha, Piliyandala; Extent: 0.1032 Hectare.

All person interested in the aforesaid Land servitude on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Land Acquisition Office located in the Head Office of the Sri Lanka Land Reclamation and Development Corporation, No. 03, Sri Jayawardenapura

Mawatha, Welikada, Rajagiriya on 25.02.2016 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 18.02.2016, the nature of their interests in the land/lands, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. C. W. ABEYSURIYA, Acquiring Officer, Wears Ganga Storm Water Drainage & Environment Improvement Project. Divisional Secretary’s Division Kesbewa.
